entities.summary: The Bactria-Margiana Archaeological Complex (BMAC) at sites like Gonur Depe in the Murghab delta — one of the great Bronze Age civilizations with monumental architecture, sophisticated crafts, and possible proto-Zoroastrian fire temples.
